summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting an ordinary share buyback transaction, not a special situation. On 10 June 2026, it purchased 5,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a VWAP of 97.4734 pence, as part of an existing buyback program announced 30 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is involved. The buyback is an ordinary capital return under an ongoing program, not a tender offer or special capital return event. This is a routine open-market purchase with no special-situation implications.
